name: Advantage Solutions, Inc.
summary:
Advantage Solutions (ADV) reported a loss of $4.12 per share on revenue of $869.60 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.38 per share on revenue of $807.64 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 984.21% while revenue grew 5.82% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it continues to expect 2026 revenue of $3.54 billion to $2.67 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $3.48 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Advantage Solutions is a leading business solutions provider committed to driving growth for consumer goods manufacturers and retailers through winning insights and execution.
subject: Advantage Solutions Missed Consensus Estimates
